name: RED
source:
Investigation assistant got a letter mentioning Luna city and the letter was posted a month ago from the location of explosion accident. So investigation started.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/06/vn-of-month-december-1992.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
调查员的助手收到一封提及露娜市的信。信件盖着一个月前的邮戳，寄出地点竟是那场爆炸事故的现场。调查就此展开。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/06/vn-of-month-december-1992.html]vndbreview[/url]]
